servinfo.title: Clutch Cover and Clutch Disc Removal and Installation

ptxt.intxrefpoff: Clutch Cover and Clutch Disc Components

s1.ptxt: Hold flywheel with special tool and remove clutch cover (1) and clutch disc.

ptxt.intxrefpoff: Clutch Cover and Clutch Disc Inspection

attention3.ptxt: Before assembling, check the following items.

item.ptxt: Contact surfaces of flywheel, pressure plate and clutch disk are clean and dry.
Old grease and dust are removed from input shaft and clutch disk hub spline.

s1.ptxt: Align clutch disc with crankshaft center using special tool (B) and install clutch cover (1).
Install and tighten clutch cover bolts using the following procedure:

s2.ptxt: Tighten other bolts (4) evenly and gradually to 5.0 N·m (0.51 kgf-m, 4.0 lbf-ft).
Fully tighten all bolts evenly and gradually to specified torque in numerical order (“1” – “6”) starting from bolt nearby strut plate rivet (2).

attention3.ptxt: For centering of clutch disc spline, tighten clutch cover bolts while pushing clutch disc with special tool.

torqueitem.t-note: 5.0 N·m → 23 N·m (0.51 kgf-m → 2.3 kgf-m, 4.0 lbf-ft → 17.0 lbf -ft)

s1.ptxt: Slightly apply grease to input shaft (1), and then join manual transaxle with engine.

attention4.ptxt: When a large quantity of grease is applied, grease may be scattered to clutch disc.
When grease is applied, reduce quantity as much as possible.

item.ptxt: When replacing clutch disc with new one, it is not necessary to apply grease to input shaft.
When inserting transaxle input shaft to clutch disc, turn crankshaft little by little to match the splines.
